name: Eneon Technologies Website & CMS
summary: The website of Eneon Technologies, my hardware and software engineering company: services, case studies and products, edited in a custom content admin that rebuilds the static site on every save.
description: eneontechnologies.com is a framework-free static site. Its case studies cover projects such as the OneGrid meter, SafeGuard LPG and the Aegis pest-detection rover, alongside eight service areas from PCB design to AI and products such as Eneon Tunnels. Staff edit projects, products, services, page text and contact details in an admin app on Render. Saves commit JSON to GitHub, a GitHub Action rebuilds the pages, and the host deploys them. Photos and videos upload to Cloudinary, and the site crops and resizes them for each place they appear.
highlights: Case-study page generated for every project, with galleries and filters by discipline
Content admin with Google, emailed-link or password sign-in, team roles and an activity log
Static output that can be hosted anywhere, rebuilt by GitHub Actions on each save
Light and dark themes, phone layout, WhatsApp contact and an enquiry form
